name: User explains low CGPA with honest context + recent evidence

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: I see your CGPA is on the lower side. Can you walk me through that?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Yes, my CGPA is 6.4. In my second year my father had a major surgery and I was the primary caregiver — that semester pulled the average down. Since then I have trended up consistently, and in the last two semesters I cleared GATE and built a sentiment analysis tool in Python that I deployed on Render. The project has 200 weekly active users from my college.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Tell me more about the project.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: It's a Flask web app trained on IMDB reviews with scikit-learn logistic regression. I added a fine-tuning loop so users can flag misclassifications and the model retrains weekly. I deployed it on Render with Postgres.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I can join from July after my final semester ends.
